ask: C++17, POSIX (linux). mapped_file.hpp and main.cpp: RAII memory-mapped file reader using open/fstat/mmap, movable, non-copyable, handles empty files, exposes span of bytes and a template view<T> with alignment check. main prints the size and first bytes of the file given in argv[1]. write the files.
prose:
I'll complete the requested file change.Both files are written. Build and run with:

```
g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -o mapped main.cpp
./mapped <file>
```

`mapped_file` is movable, non-copyable, skips `mmap` on zero-length files (returns an empty span), and `view<T>` checks both size divisibility and address alignment before handing back the typed span.
